/destination-wedding-packages (live): ranks only for generic "destination weddings all inclusive packages" (AU, pos 46). Generic multi-destination intent; no Greece term. Keep it as the commercial next step, linked prominently.

/destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages (draft): owns "greece wedding packages" and lists "all inclusive wedding packages greece" as a secondary keyword and the FAQ "Are Greek wedding packages all inclusive?". Recommend removing that secondary keyword from its map and answering the FAQ briefly with a link here.

/destination-weddings/santorini-wedding-packages (draft): owns Santorini package terms incl. "santorini wedding packages all inclusive". This page does not target Santorini terms; Santorini venues appear only as entries in the comparison.

/all-inclusive-wedding-cost and /destination-weddings/all-inclusive-wedding-cost (link map, packages topic): generic all-inclusive cost intent, no Greece ranking; low risk. Do not link (cost framing conflicts with the no-price brief).

Same intent test: about 2 to 3 of 9 top-10 results are shared with the "greece wedding packages" SERP in each city (bigfatgreekday, Tripadvisor, Facebook, Ionian Weddings); the all-inclusive SERP leans to pages titled all inclusive and forum questions. Google Ads reports the two terms separately (US 140 vs 210) but merges "all inclusive wedding packages greece" with the primary. Related but distinct sub-intent, not the same intent.

Recommendation: keep as a separate comparison page targeting the all-inclusive variant, distinct by format (named venue packages side by side by inclusions). AU demand is tiny (10 a month), so its value is qualified US and international traffic plus internal support for the Greece cluster; if the person prefers one page, fold the comparison table into the Greece guide as a section and 301 this URL.
